name: idea-loop
description: Closed loop from idea to shipped engineering, backed by a docs/ Obsidian vault as its knowledge base. Nine skills, no state machine — grill, uiux-imagine, uiux-refine and dreaming stay human-invoked (an interview, two design stages whose every exit stops on a person, and destructive disposals); the other five can also be started by a caller, so a ticket can be executed and taken to a reviewed PR without a human in the middle. No state machine either — a file's existence IS its status: a spec exists while the work is in flight, and is deleted once an ADR records why/how/result. grill runs a design-tree interview in frontier rounds (facts are the agent's job, decisions are the human's) until nothing is silently assumed, and when a product decision cannot be settled in prose it calls prototype in-session; prototype is throwaway code answering ONE question — a clickable single-file state model, or structurally distinct gray-box variants — whose artifact and verdict both land in the raw bucket; to-spec lands that conversation as a raw transcript plus one spec (problem, user stories, implementation + testing decisions, agreed seams); uiux-imagine is the divergent design half, human-invoked, and runs only while the spec sits at 等设计冻结 — it opens just the altitude still undecided (language / structure / layout / component), renders variants at the lowest fidelity that tells them apart, takes only directional notes, runs no critic, and ships exactly ONE artifact: a seven-section direction note written back into the spec, its shape checked by scripts/direction-note-check.mjs; the two uiux-* stages are a bracketed, conditional segment of the forward loop (grill → to-spec → [uiux-imagine → uiux-refine] → to-ticket → implement → pr-*): you walk them only when to-spec landed the spec at 等设计冻结, and a spec that landed at 在飞 goes straight from to-spec to to-ticket. uiux-refine is the convergent half, also human-invoked and wanting a fresh window — it rebuilds the canvas in design-preview/ from that note alone (never from imagine's renders), converges it in a two-model loop where a fresh-context critic returns findings plus a score that scripts/critic-score.mjs audits against its own findings, routes each finding by kind (direction stops for the human, pattern earns reference research, craft is fixed in place), then runs a subtraction pass and an AI-tells pass, and on the human's signature freezes the canvas, per-cell screenshots and ledger into the raw bucket, replaces the spec's direction note with a freeze summary and flips it to 在飞; to-ticket slices a spec into tracer-bullet vertical cuts with blocking edges, each a temporary credential deleted on merge, and holds the design-freeze gate for UI work; implement turns one ticket into one commit in a context holding nothing but that ticket, driving TDD at the seams the spec already agreed, never reopening the plan, and stopping to report rather than guessing when a precondition does not hold — on a UI ticket it runs the measurement/pixel comparators so visual correctness is a test that can go red — then hands off to pr-review, which opens or reuses the PR and runs up to two automatic rounds: Codex (gpt-6-sol) reviews Correctness / Standards / Spec in parallel, Claude Sonnet 5 reproduces each candidate and decides at the merge-base whether this PR introduced it, fixes what it introduced with a regression test, backlogs what it did not, has a separate agent verify each fix red to green, and publishes one GitHub post per round whose finding shape the helper enforces — stopping at mergeReady and waiting for a human merge order; dreaming reconciles every doc against origin/main — including CLAUDE.md — and proposes disposals the human approves before anything moves. The design side lives here too, not as a separate plugin: the taste and craft references under references/design/ (core law, DESIGN.md format, surface/module/component altitude protocols, the static-UI and motion protocols), a deterministic design-lint hook that fires on writes to design-preview/ and design-motion-preview/ HTML, and a headless Playwright MCP server. prototype, uiux-imagine and uiux-refine are pinned to a baseline eval under evals/ — one real case carrying a minimal DESIGN.md + PRODUCT.md, run once and archived, re-run on every change to a rubric, a prompt or a SKILL.md, with the whole loop's wiring check riding along as its assertions rather than as a one-off dry run; this is a deliberate exception to the repo-wide "subjective output skips quantitative eval" convention, stated as such next to it. Generalized out of a real project (Toeflair) — reads the current repo's own CLAUDE.md and lint/typecheck config rather than hardcoding either. Skills own the mechanics; the human owns every judgement call.
